subject: Quick deadline question
text:
Hi,

Hope your day is going okay. Quick small favor: could you glance at the ticket list and tell me which deadlines are firm? I'm trying to line up my notes, but I keep confusing the dates in the header with the follow-up dates. If the client-facing one is actually Thursday, I can push the internal check later.

No need to rewrite anything—just put a little note under each number so I won't accidentally promise someone the wrong time. I'd really appreciate it, and I can bring back the spare badges when I see you.

If it's too much at this hour, just say so and I'll wait until after the standup. I'm mostly hoping to avoid the scramble we had last time. Thanks a bunch. You're a lifesaver. Seriously. No pressure. At all.
